summary: Strengthen dividend and investment decisions with FCFE, WACC and board-governance exercises. Explore the five-day course.
lede: Dividend policy and capital allocation governance connects cash available for distribution with competing investment needs. Designed for finance leaders, treasury professionals and board-facing staff, this training helps them assess dividend cover and FCFE, model liquidity and payout scenarios, and compare project proposals using WACC, NPV and IRR. Participants also develop a board scorecard and document approval authority and supporting evidence for recommendations.
audienceIntro: This course suits professionals who prepare, review or govern dividend recommendations and competing capital requests. It is designed for roles that need to connect cash-flow evidence with investment appraisal and board approval.
prerequisites: Working familiarity with financial statements, cash-flow concepts and basic corporate finance is expected. Coding or programming is not required.
